run_single_point_orca_calculation: run a single-point DFT energy calculation using ORCA with a specified functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run a geometry optimization using ORCA with ASE relaxation and custom optimizer parameters
run_orca_calculation_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled
run_orca_calculation_metal_organics: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using UKS
run_parallel_orca_calculation: run an ORCA calculation parallelized across multiple CPU cores with configurable process count
